g.text: Colour model: flat base, one hard shadow, highlight only where allowed
Swatch = base | shadow | highlight (only on hair, shoes, a tablet screen or metal hardware). Sclera #F4F0E4, ink #221D26. Eyes never get a highlight.
shadow tint #8E86B2 · rim amber #FFC46B, cyan #7FE6E0 at 2.5px
Bottom strip: background fills with their line colour beneath (local fill darkened to 55% OKLCH lightness). Angles: 0° = light from screen right, 90° = from the top, measured counter-clockwise.
Shadow = part minus a copy of the part moved toward the light by 12% of its width (head) or 18–25% (limbs and neck). Hard edge, no outline. It flips with the light automatically.
